statBlock.name: Cranium Rat
statBlock.publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
statBlock.description: A telepathic rat with an exposed brain that glows on command.

sections.Traits: Telepathic Shroud. Divination spells and effects that read the rat's thoughts or sense its emotions have no effect on it.
sections.Actions: Bite. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 1 piercing damage.
sections.Bonus actions: Illumination. The rat can make its exposed brain shed dim light in a 5-ft. radius or turn the light off.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 83.

statBlock.name: Darkling
statBlock.publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
statBlock.description: A fey ambusher whose body erupts in blinding light when it dies.

sections.Traits:
Death Flash. When the darkling dies, its body and belongings burn to ash, except for metal and magic objects. A flash of nonmagical light fills a 10-ft. radius. Every creature in the area must pass a DC 10 Constitution save or be blinded until the end of its next turn.
Light Sensitivity. Bright light gives the darkling disadvantage on attack rolls and sight-based Wisdom (Perception) checks.
sections.Actions: Dagger. Melee or ranged weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. A hit deals 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) necrotic damage.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 84.

statBlock.name: Darkling Elder
statBlock.publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
statBlock.description: A blade-wielding elder who can conjure darkness and releases searing light at death.

sections.Traits: Death Burn. When the elder dies, its body and belongings burn to ash, except for metal and magic objects. Every creature within 10 ft. must make a DC 11 Constitution save against the flash of magical light. On a failure, it takes 7 (2d6) radiant damage and is blinded until the end of its next turn. A successful save halves the damage and prevents the blindness.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Scimitar attacks.
Scimitar. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 6 (1d6 + 3) slashing damage plus 7 (2d6) necrotic damage.
sections.Spellcasting: Darkness (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest). As an action, cast Darkness using Wisdom and without spell components.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 84.

statBlock.name: Death Kiss
statBlock.publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
statBlock.description: A hovering beholderkin that seizes prey with long tentacles and feeds on the creatures it holds.

sections.Traits: Lightning Blood. When a creature within 5 ft. hits the death kiss with a melee attack that deals piercing or slashing damage, the attacker takes 5 (1d10) lightning damage.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three Tentacle attacks. Substitute Blood Drain for any of those attacks, up to one substitution per tentacle grappling a creature.
Tentacle. Melee weapon attack, +8 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. A hit deals 11 (2d6 + 4) piercing damage. A Huge or smaller creature hit is also grappled (escape DC 14) and restrained while held. The death kiss has ten tentacles and cannot attack a different target with a tentacle that is already grappling.
Blood Drain. One creature grappled by a tentacle makes a DC 16 Constitution save. On a failure, it takes 22 (4d10) lightning damage and the death kiss regains hit points equal to half the damage.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 85.

statBlock.name: Deathlock
statBlock.publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
statBlock.description: An undead warlock that hurls bolts of necrotic magic.

sections.Languages: The languages it knew in life.
sections.Damage resistances: Necrotic. Bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks that are not silvered.
sections.Traits:
Turn Resistance. The deathlock has advantage on saving throws against effects that turn Undead.
Unusual Nature. The deathlock can go without air, food, drink, and sleep.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two attacks. Choose Deathly Claw or Grave Bolt for each.
Deathly Claw. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 9 (2d6 + 2) necrotic damage.
Grave Bolt. Ranged spell attack, +5 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. A hit deals 14 (2d10 + 3) necrotic damage.
sections.Spellcasting:
As an action, cast one of the following spells using Charisma (spell save DC 13).
At will. Detect Magic, Disguise Self, Mage Armor, Mage Hand.
1/day each. Dispel Magic, Hunger of Hadar, Invisibility, Spider Climb.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 86.

statBlock.name: Deathlock Mastermind
statBlock.publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
statBlock.description: An undead warlock that sees through magical darkness and pins enemies with shadowy tendrils.

sections.Languages: The languages it knew in life.
sections.Damage resistances: Necrotic. Bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks that are not silvered.
sections.Traits:
Devil's Sight. The deathlock sees through magical darkness within its darkvision range.
Turn Resistance. The deathlock has advantage on saving throws against effects that turn Undead.
Unusual Nature. The deathlock can go without air, food, drink, and sleep.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two attacks. Choose Deathly Claw or Grave Bolt for each.
Deathly Claw. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 13 (3d6 + 3) necrotic damage.
Grave Bolt. Ranged spell attack, +6 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. A hit deals 13 (3d8) necrotic damage. A Large or smaller target hit must pass a DC 16 Strength save or be restrained by shadowy tendrils for 1 minute. While restrained this way, the target can spend its action to repeat the save, freeing itself on a success.
sections.Spellcasting:
As an action, cast one of the following spells using Charisma (spell save DC 14).
At will. Detect Magic, Disguise Self, Mage Armor, Minor Illusion.
1/day each. Darkness, Dimension Door, Dispel Magic, Fly, Invisibility.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 87.

statBlock.name: Deathlock Wight
statBlock.publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
statBlock.description: An undead warlock whose life-draining touch can raise slain Humanoids as zombies.

sections.Languages: The languages it knew in life.
sections.Damage resistances: Necrotic. Bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks.
sections.Traits:
Sunlight Sensitivity. In sunlight the deathlock has disadvantage on attack rolls and sight-based Wisdom (Perception) checks.
Unusual Nature. The deathlock can go without air, food, drink, and sleep.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two attacks. Choose Life Drain or Grave Bolt for each.
Life Drain. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. A hit deals 6 (1d8 + 2) necrotic damage. The target must pass a DC 13 Constitution save or lose maximum hit points equal to the damage taken. The reduction lasts until the target finishes a long rest. The target dies if its hit point maximum reaches 0. A Humanoid slain by Life Drain rises as a zombie under the deathlock's control after 24 hours unless it is restored to life or its body is destroyed. The deathlock can control up to twelve zombies at a time.
Grave Bolt. Ranged spell attack, +5 to hit, range 60 ft., one target. A hit deals 12 (2d8 + 3) necrotic damage.
sections.Spellcasting:
As an action, cast one of the following spells using Charisma (spell save DC 13).
At will. Detect Magic, Disguise Self, Mage Armor.
1/day each. Fear, Hold Person.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 87.
